name: Archivist's Wrath
source: Starfinder Murder in Metal City Deluxe Adventure
description: This network of security cameras, wall-mounted retractable turrets, and laser nets are controlled by Archivist 404, who commands them to blast intruders with extreme prejudice.
disable: DC 13 Computers (trained) overrides the security program; DC 15 Crafting or DC 15 Thievery (trained) disables the hardlight projector; DC 17 Diplomacy convinces the Archivist to reconsider. Four total successes are required to end the program.
reset: Every 6 hours, a backup program restores Archivist 404's original personality data to the projector if it's been disabled.
routine: (1 action) Archivist 404 fires one laser at each intruder in the archive as one action. It takes a cumulative –1 status penalty to its attack rolls for each successful check the PCs have made to disable it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Intruder Alert!
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Archivist 404 detects intruders

Effect Dozens of tiny nodes concealed in the walls, floor, and ceiling unleash a kaleidoscopic barrage of lasers that deal 1d6 Fire Damage damage to all non-hardlight creatures in Archive 404 (Basic DC 15 Reflex Saving Throw save). Then the hazard rolls initiative.
